scope: Independent, bounded research and Figma non-destructive structural overlay for simplified 风. No new aesthetically-approved candidate. Does not restart stopped 三点失眠.

source.attributed_license: GNU LGPL 2.1 (according to source project's third-party data notice); original source https://sourceforge.net/projects/tomoe/
source.acquisition_caution: Archive calls samples 'online handwriting strokes', but the individual 4-stroke 16-point XML record alone does not prove a recorded brush session, pressure sampling, particular writer, or time course. This is a sparse stroke-sequence reference, not high-resolution genuine ink dynamics.
source.research_only_license_gate: LGPL attribution/compliance still required for redistributed modified source. Academic CASIA and SCUT DCOH real pen datasets have noncommercial/restricted license and are not used in this design test.
source.independent_structure_crosscheck: Hanzi Writer 风.json (Arphic-derived printed font medians, not a human trace) also contains four distinct strokes. https://github.com/chanind/hanzi-writer-data/blob/master/data/%E9%A3%8E.json

figma.panel_A: Tomoe four original stroke polylines, true sampled points preserved but no synthetic pen pressure
figma.panel_B: Original B editable glyph clone, user previously partially approved expressive outer structure only
figma.panel_C: Figma overlay of the four polylines on a B clone, normalized for comparative structure not pixel precision
figma.independent_readback: Confirmed page, original B original frame exists, four source vectors and four overlay vectors, and screenshot of all three panels; no writes to source B.
figma.screenshot_note: Figma screenshot actually seen, not persistently archived outside the editor.

review.technical: PASS — an existing four-stroke simplified 风 sample exists with source attribution and is displayable/editable in Figma. B was not overwritten.
review.visual: STRUCTURE_GAP_LOCATED — B's expressive outside silhouette remains usable as a partially positive direction, but its interior is overloaded with extra ink strokes. Correct reference shape has only two central cross-strokes. An overlay highlights the location of the structural problem; it does not fix style, fill or readability.
review.approval: User feedback on original B remains PARTIAL_POSITIVE_ONLY, not final.

previous_tests: AI generator regenerated wrong traditional 風 FAIL
non_repetition.new_distinction: source-record-backed four-stroke structure gate; no fresh visual candidate or prompt-driven pattern regeneration
non_repetition.no_future_auto_retries: Stop after this bounded audit. Do not keep issuing new variants without a genuinely new verified input capable of preserving both legibility and brush motion.

next: A professional calligraphy-quality glyph needs either a genuinely licensed brush stroke reference of the exact simplified target (prefer actual high resolution/trace/pressure evidence) or a human-directed authored skeleton-and-ink sketch, which can then be compared blind against B. Tomoe sparse coordinates can constrain character topology but cannot supply full brush pressure/expressiveness. Retain B original unless a candidate passes design and human review.
